description: This file is a shell script containing tests for verifying buffer handling in git's fsck functionality, specifically testing for proper handling of buffers without NUL termination and truncated objects.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the test environment by creating an empty base file.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a line with specified content to the base file.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a buffer truncation test on a specific git object type and verifies error messages.

methods.name: ident_checks
methods.description: Performs a series of identity-related buffer validation tests for commit and tag objects.
